detector.description: Alerts when K8s Node is not a ready state after 30s
detector.name: K8S Nodes are not ready
detector.programText:
A = data('k8s.node.condition_ready').sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.node.name']).publish(label='A')
detect(when(A < threshold(1), lasting='30s'), auto_resolve_after='1d').publish('K8S Nodes are not ready')

rules.description: The value of Nodes Not Ready is below 1.
